# Riti Handloom — Official Store & Catalogue Information

> Riti Handloom is a physical handloom, home furnishing showroom, and authorised Kurlon dealer located at Shop No. 14, GM Mall, Gamma 1, Jagat Farm, Greater Noida, Uttar Pradesh 201310, India.

## Store Identity & Location
- **Primary Business Name:** Riti Handloom (also searched as Riti Handlooms)
- **Address:** Shop No. 14, GM Mall, Gamma 1, Jagat Farm, Greater Noida, Uttar Pradesh 201310, India (near Punjab National Bank)
- **Phone & WhatsApp:** +91 95557 90429
- **Opening Hours:** Monday to Saturday, 9:30 AM – 9:00 PM (Closed Sunday)
- **Official Website:** https://www.ritihandloom.com/
- **Google Maps Listing:** https://www.google.com/maps?cid=15851598683298363234
- **Google Reviews Link:** https://g.page/r/CWJ3DGAEMfzbEAE/review
- **Instagram:** https://instagram.com/ritihandloom

## Authorised Dealerships & Stocked Brands
- **Authorised Dealer:** Kurlon (mattresses, sleep accessories, winter blankets)
- **Home Textile & Furnishing Brands Stocked:** D'Decor, Maspar, Boutique Living (Indo Count), SPACES (by Welspun), Metropolis (Zoya Spain), Bellagio Home, Sleeping Owls, Himeya, Orivee Designs

## Main Product Categories
- [Bedsheets](https://www.ritihandloom.com/category/bedsheets)
- [Blankets](https://www.ritihandloom.com/category/blankets)
- [Curtains](https://www.ritihandloom.com/category/curtains)
- [Window Curtains](https://www.ritihandloom.com/category/window-curtains)
- [Pillow Covers](https://www.ritihandloom.com/category/pillow-covers)
- [Towels](https://www.ritihandloom.com/category/towels)
- [Full Online Catalogue](https://www.ritihandloom.com/shop)

## How Customers Enquire & Order
- Retail and wholesale/bulk enquiries are handled directly via WhatsApp (+91 95557 90429) or in person at Shop No. 14, GM Mall, Jagat Farm, Greater Noida.
- The online catalogue showcases available collections without online payment or checkout; customers can message the store on WhatsApp for pricing, sizes, and showroom availability.
